subtitle.en: Imagine South Slope Montessori is a small preschool in Park Slope for ages 2 to 5, taught entirely in Spanish. Twelve children at most, three teachers, real Montessori work, and a sunlit studio where the language you speak at home is the language of the whole day. Families new to Spanish are welcome too.
subtitle.es: Imagine South Slope Montessori es un preescolar pequeño en Park Slope para niños de 2 a 5 años, enseñado completamente en español. Máximo doce niños, tres maestras, trabajo Montessori de verdad y un estudio lleno de luz donde el idioma que hablan en casa es el idioma de todo el día. Las familias que apenas empiezan con el español también son bienvenidas.

eyebrow.en: For families raising kids in Spanish
eyebrow.es: Para familias que crían en español

title.en: English will come on its own. Spanish needs a place to grow.
title.es: El inglés llegará solo. El español necesita un lugar donde crecer.

intro.en: If Spanish is spoken at home, you already know the worry: once school starts, English takes over. Between 2 and 5, the language a child hears all day is the one that sticks. Here, that language is Spanish.
intro.es: Si en casa se habla español, ya conoces la preocupación: en cuanto empieza la escuela, el inglés se apodera de todo. Entre los 2 y los 5 años, el idioma que un niño escucha todo el día es el que se queda. Aquí, ese idioma es el español.

title.es: Inmersión real en español, todo el día

text.en: Not a Spanish class. Songs, stories, jokes, the words for pouring and counting and making up after a squabble. Everything a two-year-old needs to say, said in Spanish by teachers who speak it with them from arrival to hasta mañana.
text.es: No es una clase de español. Canciones, cuentos, chistes, las palabras para verter, contar y reconciliarse después de una pelea. Todo lo que un niño de dos años necesita decir, dicho en español por maestras que lo hablan con ellos desde la llegada hasta el hasta mañana.

text.en: Children who use Spanish all day speak it without shyness: on the phone with grandparents, on the next trip home, at the dinner table. The language stays a bridge to family, not a school subject.
text.es: Los niños que usan el español todo el día lo hablan sin timidez: por teléfono con los abuelos, en el próximo viaje a casa, en la mesa. El idioma sigue siendo un puente con la familia, no una materia escolar.

text.en: Most of our families speak Spanish at home. Your child grows up with playmates who do the same, and you gain a small community of parents raising bilingual kids in the Slope.
text.es: La mayoría de nuestras familias hablan español en casa. Tu hijo o hija crece con amigos que hacen lo mismo, y tú ganas una pequeña comunidad de padres que crían niños bilingües en el Slope.

text.en: Music, food, holidays and stories from across the Spanish-speaking world, so the culture behind the language comes along too.
text.es: Música, comida, fiestas y cuentos de todo el mundo hispanohablante, para que la cultura detrás del idioma venga también.

title.es: Listos para el kínder de doble idioma

text.en: New York City has dozens of dual-language public programs. Our children walk in already at home in Spanish, with their first steps toward reading and writing in it.
text.es: La ciudad de Nueva York tiene decenas de programas públicos de doble idioma. Nuestros niños llegan sintiéndose en casa con el español, con sus primeros pasos hacia la lectura y la escritura.

title.en: New to Spanish at home? You're welcome here.
title.es: ¿El español es nuevo en casa? Aquí son bienvenidos.

text.en: A few of our families don't speak Spanish at home. Children understand their teachers within weeks and start answering in Spanish within months, and we keep you in the loop in English.
text.es: Algunas de nuestras familias no hablan español en casa. Los niños entienden a sus maestras en semanas y empiezan a responder en español en pocos meses, y a ti te mantenemos al tanto en inglés.

why._confirm: The claim that most families speak Spanish at home comes from Sergio's conversation on Sep 8; confirm it matches the current class before launch.

title.en: Real Montessori. Small by design. All in Spanish.
title.es: Montessori de verdad. Pequeña a propósito. Todo en español.

text.en: Montessori classrooms are calm, orderly, and full of real work: pouring, sweeping, counting, tracing letters, caring for plants. Children choose their activity and repeat it until they've mastered it, with a teacher nearby to show the next step. With three teachers for at most twelve children, nobody is a face in the crowd. And every one of those moments happens in Spanish.
text.es: Los salones Montessori son tranquilos, ordenados y llenos de trabajo real: verter, barrer, contar, trazar letras, cuidar plantas. Cada niño elige su actividad y la repite hasta dominarla, con una maestra cerca para mostrarle el siguiente paso. Con tres maestras para máximo doce niños, nadie es una cara más en el grupo. Y cada uno de esos momentos ocurre en español.

quote.en: We strive to create a program which minimizes stress in a child's life and maximizes balance, self-respect, and inborn aptitudes.
quote.es: Buscamos crear un programa que reduzca el estrés en la vida del niño y maximice el equilibrio, el respeto por sí mismo y sus aptitudes innatas.

title.es: De buenos días a hasta mañana.

text.en: Work cycle, snack and songs, the playground when the sun is out, lunch together, rest, then music, yoga, art or science. Here's the rhythm.
text.es: Ciclo de trabajo, merienda y canciones, el parque cuando hay sol, almuerzo juntos, descanso y luego música, yoga, arte o ciencia. Así es el ritmo.

intro.en: In their own words: what families have written about Imagine on Park Slope Parents.
intro.es: En sus propias palabras: lo que las familias han escrito sobre Imagine en Park Slope Parents.

title.en: Small, warm, and entirely in Spanish.
title.es: Pequeña, cálida y completamente en español.

intro.en: Imagine South Slope Montessori opened in 2015 as the first Montessori preschool in New York taught entirely in Spanish. Ten years on, we're still one mixed-age classroom of at most twelve children, led by our founder every single day. Most of our families speak Spanish at home; some are just beginning. All of them wanted a small, warm, real Montessori classroom where the whole day happens in Spanish.
intro.es: Imagine South Slope Montessori abrió en 2015 como el primer preescolar Montessori de Nueva York enseñado completamente en español. Diez años después, seguimos siendo un solo salón de edades mixtas con máximo doce niños, guiado por nuestra fundadora todos los días. La mayoría de nuestras familias hablan español en casa; algunas apenas empiezan. Todas querían un salón Montessori pequeño, cálido y de verdad, donde todo el día transcurre en español.

title.en: The whole child, at their own pace.
title.es: El niño completo, a su propio ritmo.

paragraphs.en: Imagine South Slope Montessori is a privately owned school which offers early childhood education and child care. Its philosophical foundation is the work of Dr. Maria Montessori, carried forth by educators with a specialty study in the Montessori Method.
paragraphs.es: Imagine South Slope Montessori es una escuela privada que ofrece educación y cuidado en la primera infancia. Su fundamento filosófico es la obra de la Dra. Maria Montessori, llevada adelante por educadoras con formación especializada en el Método Montessori.

paragraphs.en: Our approach is holistic and aims to develop the whole child, nurturing growth cognitively, socially, emotionally, and physically. We believe children's early years, from birth to six, are the period when they harbor the greatest capacity to learn.
paragraphs.es: Nuestro enfoque es integral y busca desarrollar al niño completo, nutriendo su crecimiento cognitivo, social, emocional y físico. Creemos que los primeros años, del nacimiento a los seis, son la etapa de mayor capacidad para aprender.

paragraphs.en: We strive to provide an enriched, stimulating environment which fosters order, coordination, concentration, and independence, where the child is an active explorer and can develop self-direction and a true love of learning.
paragraphs.es: Buscamos ofrecer un ambiente enriquecido y estimulante que fomente el orden, la coordinación, la concentración y la independencia, donde el niño sea un explorador activo y desarrolle autonomía y un verdadero amor por aprender.

paragraphs.en: We strive to create a program which minimizes stress in a child's life and maximizes balance, self-respect, and inborn aptitudes. Through the cooperative efforts of staff and parents, we aim to give each child a gift that lasts a lifetime.
paragraphs.es: Queremos crear un programa que reduzca el estrés en la vida del niño y maximice el equilibrio, el respeto por sí mismo y sus aptitudes innatas. Con el esfuerzo conjunto de maestras y familias, buscamos darle a cada niño un regalo para toda la vida.

title.en: What you'll notice on a visit
title.es: Lo que notarás en una visita

text.en: Soft voices, clear routines, classical music in the background. Children settle quickly because the room is predictable.
text.es: Voces suaves, rutinas claras, música clásica de fondo. Los niños se adaptan rápido porque el salón es predecible.

text.en: Real materials, real work. Pouring water, slicing bananas, matching sounds to letters, building the pink tower.
text.es: Materiales reales, trabajo real. Verter agua, cortar plátanos, unir sonidos con letras, construir la torre rosa.

text.en: Every teacher speaks Spanish with the children all day. The language is never a lesson; it's the air in the room.
text.es: Todas las maestras hablan español con los niños todo el día. El idioma nunca es una lección: es el aire del salón.

text.en: At most twelve children and three adults. Every child is known, every parent gets a real update at pickup.
text.es: Máximo doce niños y tres adultas. Cada niño es conocido y cada familia recibe noticias reales a la salida.

text.en: On nice days we walk to JJ Byrne Playground. On wet days we move, dance and do yoga in the studio.
text.es: Cuando hace buen tiempo caminamos a JJ Byrne Playground. Cuando llueve, nos movemos, bailamos y hacemos yoga en el estudio.

text.en: Flexible schedules, quick replies, and honest conversations about how your child is doing.
text.es: Horarios flexibles, respuestas rápidas y conversaciones honestas sobre cómo va tu hijo o hija.

edith.name: Edith Villanueva

bio.en: Edith opened Imagine South Slope Montessori in 2015 with one idea: the calm, hands-on Montessori classroom she trained in, lived entirely in Spanish. It was the first program of its kind in New York.
bio.es: Edith abrió Imagine South Slope Montessori en 2015 con una idea: el salón Montessori tranquilo y práctico en el que se formó, vivido completamente en español. Fue el primer programa de su tipo en Nueva York.

bio.en: A decade later she is still in the classroom every day, alongside two assistant teachers. Parents describe her as warm, patient, endlessly creative, and just as caring with grown-ups as with children.
bio.es: Una década después sigue en el salón todos los días, junto a dos maestras asistentes. Las familias la describen como cálida, paciente, infinitamente creativa y tan atenta con los adultos como con los niños.

edith._confirm: Add Edith's Montessori training, where she is from, and years in early childhood education.

text.en: Three adults are in the room every day, all speaking Spanish with the children: Edith and two assistant teachers. A music teacher joins us once a week.
text.es: Tres adultas están en el salón cada día, todas hablando español con los niños: Edith y dos maestras asistentes. Una maestra de música nos acompaña una vez por semana.

title.en: A dance studio full of light

text.en: Our classroom is on the third floor of Brooklyn Arts Exchange, a beloved neighborhood arts center on 5th Avenue: wood floors, tall windows, and light all day. Low shelves hold the Montessori materials at child height, a rug marks circle time, and JJ Byrne Playground is a short walk away.
text.es: Nuestro salón está en el tercer piso de Brooklyn Arts Exchange, un querido centro de artes del barrio en la 5ta Avenida: pisos de madera, ventanas altas y luz todo el día. Estantes bajos guardan los materiales Montessori a la altura de los niños, una alfombra marca el círculo, y JJ Byrne Playground está a pocos pasos.

title.en: Our Program: Spanish Immersion Montessori for Ages 2 to 5
title.es: Nuestro programa: Montessori en español para niños de 2 a 5 años

title.en: One classroom, ages 2 to 5, all in Spanish.
title.es: Un salón, de 2 a 5 años, todo en español.

intro.en: A mixed-age Montessori classroom lets the little ones learn from the big ones, and the big ones learn by leading. With at most twelve children and three teachers, every child is known.
intro.es: Un salón Montessori de edades mixtas permite que los pequeños aprendan de los grandes, y que los grandes aprendan guiando. Con máximo doce niños y tres maestras, cada niño es conocido.

title.en: From listening to thinking in Spanish
title.es: De escuchar a pensar en español

text.en: In the first weeks, routines, songs, gestures and pictures make Spanish understandable even to a brand-new two-year-old.
text.es: En las primeras semanas, las rutinas, canciones, gestos e imágenes hacen que el español sea comprensible incluso para un niño de dos años recién llegado.

text.en: Within weeks children follow instructions, stories and jokes. Understanding always comes before speaking, and that is exactly right.
text.es: En pocas semanas los niños siguen instrucciones, cuentos y chistes. Entender siempre llega antes que hablar, y así debe ser.

text.en: Single words, then phrases, then whole sentences, usually within months. We never pressure; we celebrate.
text.es: Primero palabras, luego frases, luego oraciones completas, casi siempre en pocos meses. Nunca presionamos; celebramos.

text.en: By the second year, many children switch between English and Spanish without noticing. That flexibility is the gift.
text.es: Para el segundo año, muchos niños cambian entre inglés y español sin darse cuenta. Esa flexibilidad es el regalo.

text.en: Pouring, buttoning, sweeping, preparing snack. Independence, concentration, and confident hands.
text.es: Verter, abotonar, barrer, preparar la merienda. Independencia, concentración y manos seguras.

text.en: Materials that isolate size, color, weight, sound and texture, so children learn to notice and compare.
text.es: Materiales que aíslan tamaño, color, peso, sonido y textura, para aprender a observar y comparar.

text.en: Rich Spanish vocabulary, sound games, sandpaper letters and the first steps into reading and writing.
text.es: Vocabulario rico en español, juegos de sonidos, letras de lija y los primeros pasos hacia la lectura y la escritura.

text.en: Counting beads, number rods and the decimal system, held in the hands before it lives in the head.
text.es: Cuentas para contar, barras numéricas y el sistema decimal, en las manos antes que en la cabeza.

text.en: Maps, animals, plants, the seasons, and the traditions of the Spanish-speaking world.
text.es: Mapas, animales, plantas, las estaciones y las tradiciones del mundo hispanohablante.

text.en: Singing every day, and a visiting music teacher once a week.
text.es: Cantamos todos los días, y una maestra de música nos visita una vez por semana.

text.en: Simple poses and quiet breathing, so children learn to find calm in their own bodies.
text.es: Posturas sencillas y respiración tranquila, para que los niños aprendan a encontrar la calma en su propio cuerpo.

text.en: Paint, clay, collage and plenty of process over product.
text.es: Pintura, arcilla, collage y mucho proceso por encima del resultado.

text.en: JJ Byrne Playground on nice days, and big movement indoors when the weather says no.
text.es: JJ Byrne Playground cuando hace buen tiempo, y mucho movimiento adentro cuando el clima dice que no.

note.en: A typical day. Times are approximate and follow the children.
note.es: Un día típico. Los horarios son aproximados y siguen a los niños.

text.en: Arrival, hang up your coat, greet your friends in Spanish.
text.es: Llegada, colgar el abrigo, saludar a los amigos en español.

text.en: Children choose Montessori materials; teachers give one-on-one lessons.
text.es: Los niños eligen materiales Montessori; las maestras dan lecciones individuales.

text.en: Songs, the calendar, and a story in Spanish.
text.es: Canciones, el calendario y un cuento en español.

text.en: The playground on nice days; movement and yoga in the studio when it rains.
text.es: El parque cuando hace buen tiempo; movimiento y yoga en el estudio cuando llueve.

text.en: Packed from home, eaten together at the table, in Spanish.
text.es: Traído de casa y compartido en la mesa, en español.

text.en: Younger children rest; older children keep working.
text.es: Los más pequeños descansan; los mayores siguen trabajando.

text.en: The special of the day, from our music teacher to hands-on experiments.
text.es: La actividad especial del día, desde la maestra de música hasta experimentos con las manos.

text.en: A last story, then pickup at 3:00 with a real update for parents.
text.es: Un último cuento y salida a las 3:00 con noticias reales para las familias.

day._confirm: Adjust times and activities to match the real day. Confirm whether lunch is packed from home and whether snack is provided.

text.en: Our day runs Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. It's short on purpose: long enough for a full Montessori work cycle, lunch, rest and time outside, and short enough that two- and three-year-olds go home happy rather than exhausted. We don't offer early drop-off or extended day. Families choose two, three or five days a week.
text.es: Nuestro día va de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 AM a 3:00 PM. Es corto a propósito: suficiente para un ciclo de trabajo Montessori completo, almuerzo, descanso y tiempo al aire libre, y lo bastante corto para que los niños de dos y tres años vuelvan a casa contentos y no agotados. No ofrecemos entrada temprana ni horario extendido. Las familias eligen dos, tres o cinco días por semana.

note.es: Un comienzo suave para los de dos años

intro.en: Call, email, or send the form. We reply within a day or two, in English or Spanish.
intro.es: Llama, escribe o envía el formulario. Respondemos en uno o dos días, en inglés o en español.

items.en: Subway: F, G or R to 4th Ave–9th St, then two blocks up 8th Street. F or G to 7th Avenue also works.
items.es: Metro: F, G o R hasta 4th Ave–9th St, luego dos cuadras por la calle 8. F o G hasta 7th Avenue también funciona.

items.en: Bus: B63 along 5th Avenue stops at the door.
items.es: Autobús: el B63 por la 5ta Avenida para en la puerta.

items.en: Enter through the BAX lobby and take the stairs or elevator to the 3rd floor, Studio C.
items.es: Entra por el vestíbulo de BAX y sube por las escaleras o el elevador al tercer piso, Studio C.

items.en: Strollers are welcome; there's room to park them inside.
items.es: Las carriolas son bienvenidas; hay espacio para dejarlas adentro.

directions._confirm: Confirm the elevator and stroller details with BAX.

q.en: We speak Spanish at home. What does Imagine add?
q.es: Hablamos español en casa. ¿Qué aporta Imagine?

a.en: A whole day in Spanish, with other children, at the age when it matters most. At home your child hears Spanish from one or two people; here they hear it from three teachers and eleven friends, in songs, stories, negotiations over the pink tower, and the words for everything in the room. Most children's Spanish jumps within a few months, and it stays theirs once English arrives.
a.es: Un día completo en español, con otros niños, a la edad en que más importa. En casa tu hijo escucha español de una o dos personas; aquí lo escucha de tres maestras y once amigos, en canciones, cuentos, negociaciones por la torre rosa y las palabras de todo lo que hay en el salón. El español de la mayoría de los niños da un salto en pocos meses, y sigue siendo suyo cuando llega el inglés.

q.en: Do the teachers really speak only Spanish with the children?
q.es: ¿Las maestras de verdad hablan solo español con los niños?

a.en: Yes, all day, from buenos días to hasta mañana. Updates to parents come in Spanish or English, whichever you prefer.
a.es: Sí, todo el día, desde buenos días hasta hasta mañana. Las noticias para las familias llegan en español o en inglés, como prefieras.

a.en: At most twelve children, with three adults in the room: Edith and two assistant teachers.
a.es: Máximo doce niños, con tres adultas en el salón: Edith y dos maestras asistentes.

q.en: Do you offer early drop-off or late pickup?

a.en: Not right now. Our day is 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Monday to Friday. If your family needs longer hours, tell us on the tour and we'll talk through what could work.
a.es: Por ahora no. Nuestro día es de 9:00 AM a 3:00 PM, de lunes a viernes. Si tu familia necesita más horas, cuéntanos en la visita y conversamos qué podría funcionar.

faq._confirm: Confirm there is no early drop-off or extended day, and whether Edith wants to offer it.

q.en: We don't speak Spanish at home. Will my child be lost?
q.es: No hablamos español en casa. ¿Mi hijo se va a perder?

a.en: No. Most of our families speak only English at home. Teachers use routines, songs, gestures and pictures so a brand-new child understands from day one, and comprehension grows within weeks. You'll get updates in English (or Spanish, if you prefer).
a.es: No. La mayoría de nuestras familias solo hablan inglés en casa. Las maestras usan rutinas, canciones, gestos e imágenes para que un niño recién llegado entienda desde el primer día, y la comprensión crece en semanas. Recibirás noticias en inglés (o en español, si prefieres).

a.en: Children join us between ages 2 and 5 and share one mixed-age classroom. Younger children learn by watching the older ones; older children learn by helping.
a.es: Los niños se unen entre los 2 y los 5 años y comparten un solo salón de edades mixtas. Los más pequeños aprenden observando a los mayores; los mayores aprenden ayudando.

a.en: Yes. Families choose two, three or five days a week, always 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Many start with two days and add more later.
a.es: Sí. Las familias eligen dos, tres o cinco días por semana, siempre de 9:00 AM a 3:00 PM. Muchas empiezan con dos días y agregan más después.

faq._confirm: Match to the real schedule options.

a.en: Yes, as often as the weather allows. We walk to JJ Byrne Playground in Washington Park, a few minutes away, and on rainy days we dance, move and do yoga in our big studio.
a.es: Sí, siempre que el clima lo permite. Caminamos a JJ Byrne Playground en Washington Park, a unos minutos, y cuando llueve bailamos, nos movemos y hacemos yoga en nuestro amplio estudio.

q.en: Does my child need to be potty trained?
q.es: ¿Mi hijo necesita saber ir al baño?

a.en: No. Many two-year-olds join us in diapers. Toileting is part of Montessori practical life, and we support it gently and in step with you.
a.es: No. Muchos niños de dos años llegan con pañal. Aprender a ir al baño es parte de la vida práctica Montessori, y lo apoyamos con calma y en coordinación contigo.

a.en: Children bring a packed lunch from home and eat together at the table. Helping to prepare and serve snack is one of the children's favorite practical-life jobs.
a.es: Los niños traen su almuerzo de casa y comen juntos en la mesa. Ayudar a preparar y servir la merienda es uno de los trabajos de vida práctica favoritos de los niños.

faq._confirm: Confirm whether snack is provided by the school.

a.en: It depends on the schedule. Ask for the current rate sheet when you book a tour. There is a $125 non-refundable registration fee with your application.
a.es: Depende del horario. Pide la lista de precios actual cuando agendes tu visita. Hay una cuota de inscripción de $125, no reembolsable, con tu solicitud.

a.en: Visit, then complete the enrollment application and pay the registration fee. We'll contact you to set up a child interview and classroom observation, then confirm your start date.
a.es: Visítanos, luego completa la solicitud de inscripción y paga la cuota. Te contactaremos para programar una entrevista con tu hijo o hija y una observación en el salón, y después confirmamos la fecha de inicio.

a.en: Inside Brooklyn Arts Exchange at 421 5th Avenue and 8th Street in Park Slope, third floor, Studio C. The 4th Ave–9th St station (F, G, R) is a few blocks away and the B63 bus stops outside.
a.es: Dentro de Brooklyn Arts Exchange, en 421 5th Avenue con la calle 8 en Park Slope, tercer piso, Studio C. La estación 4th Ave–9th St (F, G, R) está a pocas cuadras y el autobús B63 para afuera.

a.en: Our children go on to public, dual-language and independent kindergartens across Brooklyn. They arrive confident, independent, and comfortable in two languages.
a.es: Nuestros niños continúan en kínders públicos, de doble idioma e independientes por todo Brooklyn. Llegan seguros, independientes y cómodos en dos idiomas.

quote.en: It is amazing to see two year olds singing, three year olds doing addition, and four year olds reading, all in Spanish and with joy.
quote.es: Es increíble ver a niños de dos años cantando, de tres años sumando y de cuatro años leyendo, todo en español y con alegría.

full.en: Imagine South Slope Montessori has been perfect for our kids and all the other lovely families we have known there. The teachers are loving, playful, creative, thoughtful, and patient with the kids, and communicative and flexible with the parents. It is amazing to see two year olds singing, three year olds doing addition, and four year olds reading, all in Spanish and with joy. We chose it even over really good free pre-k...it's simply the best experience you can find.

quote.en: Our daughter is also fluent in Spanish, which is amazing given we don’t speak any ourselves.
quote.es: Nuestra hija además habla español con fluidez, algo increíble porque nosotros no lo hablamos.

full.en: Edith’s Spanish Immersion Montessori is incredible. Our daughter just got accepted into Hunter College Elementary for kindergarten and I credited Edith a lot for this. Edith and her teachers are caring, intelligent, warm and focused on each child’s individual needs. Edith nurtured our daughter’s intellectual curiosity and desire to be challenged academically. Our daughter is also fluent in Spanish, which is amazing given we don’t speak any ourselves. The space is wonderful and light filled with dual aspect windows. It is a mixed aged class, which we love as allows for different roles as your child ages. It’s a small school with maximum 12 kids across 3 teachers and very flexible on scheduling. We did full time 5 days a week, which worked for us and really maximized the benefits for our daughter. We’ve also found a wonderful community of other parents. It really flies under the radar as a school and it deserves more recognition given how incredible it is. It was one of the best decisions we’ve ever made for our family.

quote.en: We love this school beyond words.
quote.es: Amamos esta escuela más de lo que las palabras pueden decir.

full.en: I have one child who completed three years at ISSM, and another who is beginning his third year (Pre-K) there this fall. We love this school beyond words. Edith, the director, truly connects with each child as an individual and strives to adapt to their needs. The assistant teachers have also been wonderful, nurturing, and creative. This is a Montessori school where the kids learn to make choices and exercise independence on what they work on. There is structure, but they work with each child's natural inquisitiveness rather than impose a strict plan. I found it to be a wonderful place for my kids, who have different temperaments and interests. Many families over the years have gone out of their way to stick with ISSM through multiple kids, even through changing life circumstances, which really speaks to what a special place it is. This is a single-classroom facility in BAX, but it's a wide open space, and the teachers rotate the materials throughout the week. For physical activity, there is a trampoline, a slide, a Pikler triangle and ramp, which get rotated in and out of the space as the days go on. They also go outside to JJ Byrne some days. The school has a music teacher visit once or twice a week, to sing and encourage the kids to stand up and dance. I got to participate in some of these lessons when everything was closed in 2020, and I could see for myself why the kids love them! The fact that it's a single classroom also means it is mixed-age, which I also found worked wonderfully for my kids. While sharing the classroom with kids of a different age, I found that it gave them a sense of perspective and empathy. In the older kids, they saw role models, and towards the younger kids, and I saw them develop a sense of nurturing that is very sweet. Their relationship to the classroom and their classmates changed every year as they got older. ISSM is a Spanish-immersion school, and I can also attest to the high quality of their instruction in Spanish. They do a great job maintaining the immersive quality while working with kids of various levels of proficiency. If you value a Montessori education, Spanish immersion, or both, you should definitely check out Imagine South Slope Montessori. Amenities: They visit a nearby playground with the kids some mornings. So they do not have private outdoor space, but they go outdoors nonetheless.

full.en: Imagine South Slope Montessori is run by Edith who has incredible passion and talent for nurturing children. She has 2 teaching aids (so 3 teachers total) and a class size max of only 10 children. All teachers speak exclusively in Spanish so your child (like mine) will become fluent in Spanish. My daughter now reads and writes in Spanish. Fantastic facility, very reasonable price, cannot recommend enough.

quote.en: I recommend it without hesitation! It is truly a hidden gem.
quote.es: ¡La recomiendo sin dudarlo! Es una verdadera joya escondida.

full.en: My two kids, now in second grade and kindergarten, each spent 3 years at Imagine South Slope Montessori. I recommend it without hesitation! It is truly a hidden gem. To answer your specific questions based on our family's experience: 1) Did you also find that your child seemed to have enough time in creative activities and/or just play more generally? My oldest came home each day with several paintings, my youngest not so much. It turned out he just much more enjoyed leafing through books on his own, at age 2. He developed into an early reader, and became more inspired to draw and paint during Pre-K. Meanwhile my oldest took longer to read confidently, but was very craftsy. They both now read above grade-level in English and Spanish, and are as imaginative and creative as can be. I guess this is my long-winded way of saying, yes, each child seemed to get the amount and type of creative activities that they needed, when they were ready to learn from them. I liked that about the Montessori approach, especially at such a young age. 2) Given that so much of Montessori work time is independent, did you also find that your child got a good balance of social / group play and development? During my classroom visits, I observed that although the kids independently choose what to work on, you'll often see 2 or more kids working together (or at least in parallel, for the younger ones) on a given activity. It seems like kids naturally like to do what they see other kids doing, so it worked out that way. As my kids got older, sometimes I would see them helping the younger kids on an activity--so incredibly sweet. This was great for both kids, but especially my youngest, since he got a chance to be the leader and the older kid for a change. They both made great friends there. Just to add a couple of other points that might be interesting for you or others: - For extended hours (past 3pm), it is possible to coordinate drop-off at a nearby Beansprouts (but most families have a nanny or a parent pick up) - Many families depart for Pre-K, partly for the cost savings, but also because they expect their kids would be more challenged if they're around older kids. I am glad I kept both of my kids there until they were ready for Kindergarten. Edith always kept them challenged and engaged, and they each got to be the big kid on campus for a year. They were both beyond ready for Kindergarten.

quote.en: The smallness really gives the kids a good chance to bond with each other and with the teachers.
quote.es: Que sea tan pequeña les da a los niños una verdadera oportunidad de conectar entre ellos y con las maestras.

full.en: I would also like to sing the praises of ISSM. The part-time scheduling options and mixed age group format drew us here. The space itself is a beautiful dance studio with wood floors, full light and big windows. Edith sets the mood with classical music. The teachers set up very cute and fun stations and rotate the materials frequently. Our daughter's Spanish comprehension has really grown from attending just two days a week, on nice days they get lots of playground time, and there's a music teacher who comes once a week. But I think what I appreciate most is the loving teachers. First of all, sometimes at pickup it's like, 4 or 5 kids total with 3 teachers. The smallness really gives the kids a good chance to bond with each other and with the teachers. And it makes possible the little moments of tenderness that I observe, like when I pick up my daughter and her hair is braided, because her ponytail had come loose and one of her teachers took the time to secure her hair back. It also seems like they appreciate her for who she is and encourage her interests. At parent-teacher conference, Edith told us our daughter likes to dance throughout the day and she recognizes it being her form of self-expression. So they don't redirect her or anything like that, they let her do her thing and encourage her. And they've had like 4 piñatas this year for special occasions!

full.en: My two kids, who are now 8 & 10, each spent 3 years with Edith at Imagine. Socially, it was incredible. So much that our kids are still friends with kids from two separate families we met there. Both of my kids are very creative, so much that our 10 year old is currently applying to by audition only arts middle school. They both had a great time and remember Edith and their time there fondly. They were both doing so well that we opted to skip pre-k and keep them there until they were ready for Kindergarten. In school now, they're both doing well socially, are able to work independently, and are both performing academically above grade level.

quote.en: Edith, the owner & head teacher, has been so wonderful with our daughter and caring for all of us.
quote.es: Edith, la dueña y maestra principal, ha sido maravillosa con nuestra hija y nos ha cuidado a todos.

full.en: I wanted to share the incredibly positive experience we've had as a family with Imagine South Slope Montessori (in the BAX building on 5th Ave & 8th St). We moved back to the US from my home country in February. It was the first time our 3 year old daughter was being cared for in a setting outside her home and none of us speak Spanish so there was a lot of change to navigate. We have been so lucky. Edith, the owner & head teacher, has been so wonderful with our daughter and caring for all of us. [Our daughter] has been learning Spanish and is really thriving at the school. She's happy, she's making friends & she asks me everyday if she can go to school today, being disappointed when the answer is no on weekends. The environment & setting is wonderful with large dual aspect windows. My daughter loves to do painting and comes home proudly showing me the artwork she's done everyday. The other parents are lovely and we've found a real sense of community. If you're looking for a Montessori setting, I cannot recommend Edith & her school enough.

quote.en: They teach empathy and caring for one another. Such a warm environment.
quote.es: Enseñan empatía y a cuidarse unos a otros. Un ambiente muy cálido.

full.en: Our first child spent 3.5 years going here and they loved it so much! They were always very excited for each day and missed her classmates and teachers during the summer. They worked on reading, writing, maths, art etc. It being a montessori place it was whatever activity your kid was into. They teach empathy and caring for one another. Such a warm environment. The owner, edith is such a special person, she really cares for the children and is such a pleasure to work with. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience! It’s also Spanish immersion which means they only speak Spanish with the children. We don’t speak it at home but it was still easy to communicate with the teachers. And our kid has learned so much of the language and is excited to keep learning more. Children are language sensitive when very young so if you want them to learn, this is the time! We loved it so much that we’re sending out second child there. It really is a beautiful environment. Amenities: Visits to the playground/park

full.en: Imagine South Slope Montessori might be a little far for you (5th Ave near 8th St), but it is truly wonderful. It’s a small school, so they have one mixed-ages classroom. The educators speak Spanish natively and professionally. They get a good school-ready pre-education there. They visit the playground (weather permitting) and have music class weekly. We’ve also found a great sense of community there. I sent my two kids there since they turned 2. One has moved on to Kindergarten and the other still attended. Before they were 2, we had a nanny. And we’ve continued to work with our nanny since this helps us cover the times they’re not in school.

full.en: [Our son] was going to Imagine South Slope Montessori before the pandemic started; it’s a teeny little Spanish immersion school in the BAX building ([one of us] is from Argentina so we’re a bilingual household) and we LOVE it. They closed in March but reopened this fall and we started sending him back a few weeks ago, a hard choice but they are doing a great job with ventilation and safety and all the kids wear their masks all day, which really surprised me.
